This supplement uses the same saved evidence as the app and does not fit models.
The official test was previously viewed. At most ten constructed inputs can still
aggregate twenty source factors; the formal rubric interpretation needs review.

```{python}
import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
os.environ['MLFACTOR_READ_ONLY'] = '1'
ROOT = Path.cwd()
if not (ROOT / 'published').is_dir(): ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from published_results import PublishedStrategies
from engineering_ui import METHOD_NOTES, _curves
import pandas as pd
reader = PublishedStrategies(ROOT / 'published/project').analysis_section('engineering')
training, final = reader.study('training'), reader.study('test')
pd.DataFrame([{'Recipe': k, 'Construction': v} for k, v in METHOD_NOTES.items()])
```

## Training, search and final evaluation

Each learned transformation is fitted inside its chronological training fold.
The early-training search minimizes binary event log loss. Fixed and tuned models
are scored on January 2007–December 2009, then separately refitted once at the
December 2009 final origin using training data only. Stock groups and technical
signals subsequently use only returns already earned. Trading rules are fixed;
residual cash earns zero and results are gross of trading costs.

```{python}
training['trials'][['recipe', 'model_key', 'target', 'params', 'mean_cv_log_loss', 'rank']].head(12)
```

## An example: logistic downside adjustment on the K-means top-ten book

The app allows all four classifiers, both directions, six starting portfolios and
all six recipes. This report shows one declared example, rather than selecting a
winner from test results.

```{python}
final['metrics'].query("book == 'K-means top 10' and model_key == 'logistic' and target == 'loss'")[[
    'recipe', 'status', 'cagr', 'annualized_log_growth', 'sharpe', 'max_drawdown', 'avg_cash_weight']]
```

```{python}
rows = final['monthly']
rows = rows.loc[rows.book.eq('K-means top 10') & (rows.recipe.eq('original') | (
    rows.model_key.eq('logistic') & rows.target.eq('loss') & rows.status.eq('Tuned')))]
from IPython.display import HTML, display
from research.engineering_reporting import standalone_figure_html
display(HTML(standalone_figure_html(_curves(rows, 'Cumulative log return'))))
```

Unsupervised feature construction does not guarantee useful forecasts. Differences
in validation/test performance, risk and cash exposure should be examined without
reselecting the recipe on the official test. This supplement does not replace
formal project release/signoff.
